newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido to boost China joint venture output.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido to boost China joint venture output.

text.p: Shiseido Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would invest about 660 million yen to increase output at its joint venture in China.

Shiseido plans a fivefold increase in output of cosmetics and other products by 2000 at Shiseido Liyuan Cosmetics Co Ltd (SLC), which is 65 percent owned by Shiseido and 35 percent by Beijing Liyuan Cosmetics Co Ltd.
SLC's production capacity was 1.8 million units in 1996.
Construction of new facilities will start in February 1998. They are expected to be operational in July 1999, Japan's leading cosmetics maker said.
The joint venture posted total sales of 1.3 billion yen in the business year ended March 1997, up 153 percent from the previous year, Shiseido said.
"This expansion is part of a series of moves worldwide aimed at increasing consolidated overseas sales to 200 billion yen by 2000," a Shiseido spokesman said.
Shiseido is building up its facilities overseas, such as in in North America and France.
